identity: 法鼓文理學院綜合大樓（GA／GB／GC），金山校本部；完整相連三翼一套，不是整校或大願橋。
scope: Source-bound complete principal exterior approximation, including observable court levels, galleries, stairs and lightwell negative spaces. Not a survey/as-built model or a physical-print certification.
review_method: Personally viewed all five final PNGs plus the uncut/unhidden supplementary courtyard rendering. Compared with the separately reviewed original plans/sections and completion photographs, including renewed viewing of architect-12/14/19 and mag-2. Read final generator and documentation. Independently parsed actual STL/mesh.json/3MF and ran non-axis ray tests on 46 final mesh points; did not rely solely on screenshots or builder assertions.

Three broad shallower runs and intermediate landings now connect court levels; the near-vertical terminal flight is gone. Stair tread count, precise rise/run and planting widths remain model approximations, not measured architectural dimensions.

revisions_verified.issue: GA rear top glazing flush with outer frame
revisions_verified.result: Rear top-storey glass is recessed behind the substantial frame, consistent with mag-2 and high oblique photos; front and rear are not simply duplicated.

revisions_verified.result: Neutral dark flat cap added where visible on GA roof, not claimed to be PV; fan-shaped green roofs raised above surrounding terrace, preserving their curved walls rather than flattening them into paving.

per_view.qa/courtyard-detail.png: Personally viewed supplementary real-mesh image. It exposes court floor, platforms, three broad flights, branch stair and side-gallery undersides without a clipping plane or hidden model parts. Two studio fill lights/64 samples/no denoising are recorded by builder; this is a model QA view, not a source photograph.

limits: Author project dates to 2015; completion-photo DateTimeOriginal is absent/unknown. Official usage handbook is 2020; its 2025/10 URL is upload metadata. Not asserted as photographed in 2015, fully surveyed as-built, or current in 2026.

No complete reliable dimensioned measurement set: plan is proportionally read, window/grid/railing counts, small equipment and planted details are approximate. Roof colours and opaque glass are miniature proxies rather than calibrated material measurements.
Interior rooms and buried structures are simplified closed masses. The cutaway drawing does not license permanent garage cutaway facades. Display base/grade support is not a full terrain survey.
Three lecture-hall roofs are quarter-sector/fan-like, not three generic semicircles; rooflight drums are opaque glass proxies with voids below, not asserted solid ventilation cylinders.

Actual builder layer report retains 10 failing horizontal thin-island levels out of 299 global slices; local 0.378 mm rooflight cap / 0.525 mm crossbar / other fine mullions may merge or disappear in FFF. Gallery slabs/frame overhangs/stairs need support planning. No physical print, slicer/toolpath or engineering safety certification.

Own raw checks establish edge incidence/orientation, connected surface, normals and exact exchange, not an exhaustive self-intersection or vertex-link proof. Blender edit/save/reopen, strict lib3mf roundtrip and isolated reconstruction reports are builder evidence inspected, not independently rerun here.

No original third-party source images/PDFs are authorized for inclusion in the public model package. Subsequent package closure must verify actual ZIP members; this visual PASS alone is not upload authority.
